Little Angel Theatre were The Stage Awards’ Fringe Theatre of the Year in 2024!

Make a donation today to help Little Angel Theatre give the gift of puppetry to as many children as possible.

Suggested donations:

  • £5 per month helps pay for materials for our ongoing free workshops in the community
  • £25 per month helps pay for performances of our suitcase show to isolated children in hospital or a refugee family in a bridging hotel
  • £50 per month helps pay for tickets for local school children to attend our shows
  • £100 per month helps to support our artist development work, creating the puppeteers and puppet makers of the future

🙏 Donate now

If you are able to support us, any donation, large or small, will make a huge difference.

All amounts are welcome. Thank you!

What's on at our venues

We perform at two venues – Little Angel Theatre and Little Angel Studios. Plan your visit >

Don’t miss our Children’s Puppet Festival, now in its fourth year! See the full line up here.

Can’t make it to our venues? Stream our shows from the comfort of your own living room with our online shows!

Marionettes: An Exhibition Celebrating String Puppets

Marionettes: An Exhibition Celebrating String Puppets

29 August–6 September 2026
To celebrate our 65th birthday, we’re bringing together historic and newly made marionettes in this landmark free exhibition.  For the first time in a generation, we will be showcasing work by leading British makers across six decades, from Little Angel Theatre founders John and Lyndie Wright to a new generation of artists.

Scruff's Christmas Adventure

Scruff's Christmas Adventure

28 November–3 January 2027
It’s Christmas Eve, and Scruff the puppy can’t sleep. He whines and worries – how can a little dog like him find a totally paw-some gift for his owner? He doesn’t know where to start, let alone how to wrap it and get it under the tree in time for Christmas morning.

Aimed at ages 3-6

What’s on on tour

Want to find out the latest information about our shows on tour?

Find out more.

Hire us for your child’s Birthday Party!

There is no better way to celebrate your little one’s special day than a thrilling puppet performance!

Our Miniature shows can come to your London Venue or we can host your party in one of our studio spaces. All of our shows are fun, interactive puppet shows specifically designed for parties!

Find out more

Buy a gift voucher

Treat your loved ones to a special theatre trip this Christmas or to celebrate a birthday or special occasion.

Gift vouchers can be bought online and are valid for two years from the date of purchase.

Buy now

Can’t make it to our venues in person?

Watch Online

We have lots of exciting shows for you in our Watch, Make, Share series.
Our Home shows are free but if you enjoy them, please donate.
View all online shows

People behind the puppets

Over the past 60 years, a huge range of designers have brought their unique puppet designs to life on the Little Angel Theatre stage. In this new online series, Little Angel’s very own Little Angel puppet will meet and interview several different designers to find out more about their experiences of puppetry design and why they love working in the field.

Watch now!

Bertie

Bertie… is our brand new first-ever digital series!

Bertie is an environmental entertainment and education series or children aged 3 to 8 on LAT’s YouTube Channel.  Children will learn about different environmental issues and consider how they can take their own steps to help combat climate change.

All puppets and set have been designed and made using found and recycled materials – LAT is committed to environmental sustainability in our actions as well as in our content.
